strategy.name: Ichimoku Kinko Hyo Cloud
strategy.summary: Only A+ setups where price, the future cloud, Tenkan/Kijun and Chikou all agree; trail on the Kijun.

rules.text: Price above the cloud; future cloud bullish; Tenkan above Kijun; Chikou in open space.
rules.checklistQuestion: Were all four Ichimoku conditions bullish?

rules.text: Pullback option: buy a touch-and-bounce of a flat Kijun in an established trend.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was it a bounce from a flat Kijun?

rules.text: Stop 5 pips beyond a flat Kijun, or the other side of the cloud.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop beyond the Kijun or cloud?

rules.text: Trail along the Kijun until a candle closes beyond it.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you exit on a close beyond the Kijun?

rules.text: No trade when price is inside the cloud or Chikou is congested.
